sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 40 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases wind elemental attack by 4 for 90 seconds.
Only [Five Sacred Beasts] Byakko can be used as Unlocking Potential material
